questions.q: When can props stay on the drone on the bench?
options: When the battery is not connected
When the ARM switch is off
questions.explain: The only reliable rule: no props on the bench. Any exception will one day end in an injury.

questions.q: What does the RXLOSS arming disable flag mean?
questions.explain: Without a valid receiver signal Betaflight won't let you arm.

questions.q: A Betaflight drone won't arm, the OSD shows ARM_SWITCH (before 2025.12 — ARMSWITCH). The cause?
questions.explain: ARM_SWITCH is set when the ARM switch is on while any other block is active; in the OSD it is shown only if it is the only one left. Lower the switch and raise it again.

questions.q: What do you do if an arming disable flag stops you from taking off?
questions.explain: The flags are a safeguard. Disabling the check removes the symptom, not the danger.

questions.q: What is the PREARM mode for?
options: For a motor test without props
questions.explain: Two-stage arming reduces the chance of accidental arming — especially with heavy props.

questions.q: What do you do with a battery that heats up without a load after a crash?
options: Discharge it to zero with a flashlight
questions.explain: Heating without a load is a sign of an internal short. Such a battery is taken out of service.

questions.q: The DSHOT_TELEM flag in status means:
options: No eRPM with the RPM filter on
Throttle not at zero when arming
questions.explain: Check dshot_bidir, the ESC firmware, the wires.

questions.q: How do you put out a burning LiPo?
options: With sand and a non-flammable container
With a little water from a bottle
questions.explain: It burns with its own oxidizer; the key is isolation and cooling.
